k5te01.title: Aries, slow down for once
k5te01.caption:
Aries, not every crush is a race.
Ask, then actually listen. The right one keeps pace with you.

k5te02.title: Taurus, the comfort zone talk
k5te02.caption:
Taurus, put the snack down for one second.
New can feel safe too, and you deserve to be chosen loudly.

k5te03.title: Gemini, say the real thing
k5te03.caption:
Gemini, which tab are you even on right now?
Pick one chat tonight and say the second thought out loud.

k5te04.title: Cancer, who is taking care of you
k5te04.caption:
Cancer, you feed everyone. Who is feeding you?
Let someone take care of you for once. It counts.

k5te05.title: Leo, the spotlight can wait
k5te05.caption:
Leo, the spotlight left and you're still glowing.
You're loved off-stage too. Quiet nights count.

k5te06.title: Virgo, the text was already fine
k5te06.caption:
Virgo, draft fourteen? Draft one was perfect.
You can't edit a feeling. Send it, then breathe.

k5te07.title: Libra, you're allowed to choose
k5te07.caption:
Libra, still deciding where to eat?
Your opinion is welcome here, and no is a full sentence.

k5te08.title: Scorpio, not everything is a clue
k5te08.caption:
Scorpio, "seen 2h ago" is not a case file.
Ask instead of decoding. Trust can be built slowly.

k5te09.title: Sagittarius, staying isn't a cage
k5te09.caption:
Sagittarius, unpack the suitcase. Just for tonight.
Staying isn't a cage, and home can be an adventure.

k5te10.title: Capricorn, love isn't a meeting
k5te10.caption:
Capricorn, it's 2 a.m. and love isn't a calendar invite.
Your worth isn't your output. Let someone hold you.
